plan.title: EXP-DRAFT-044 Publish Hidden on Saved eRFX Draft

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the test.
Set the company configuration under test so vendors cannot be added during event creation.
Apply the additional configuration specified for the saved-draft scenario.
Give the draft a title so it can be saved and located in the Drafts list.
Apply the first available template required for a valid draft setup.
Add one line item to create a realistic saved eRFX draft.
Complete the pricing sheet for the draft line item.
Commit a schedule so the draft contains the normal event configuration.
Save the eRFX event as a draft.
Confirm the draft save did not produce an application error.
Navigate to the events list to reopen the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the scenario.
Verify that the draft created by this plan appears in the Drafts list.
Confirm the listed event has Draft status.
Open the draft event from the Drafts list.
Assert the Publish control is not offered on the reopened eRFX draft.
